verdict.rationale: Productboard's own marketing explicitly claims automatic insight detection linked to feature ideas (docs-16), directly matching the story, and the API/Insights endpoints (docs-19 mentions 'Insights usage' metrics) corroborate an insights feature exists. However, there is only a single vendor claim with no detailed documentation of the AI detection mechanism, no independent/hands-on verification of accuracy, and no detail on how linking works or its reliability. Missing for 10: independent validation of AI detection accuracy, detailed docs on the insight-linking algorithm, and hands-on user reports confirming it works as claimed.
